question: In which year was the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD), better known as the World Bank, established to help Europe recover from the devastation of World War II?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1944**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The World Bank** is made up of two primary institutions: **the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) and the International Development Association (IDA)**.
 
• **The International Development Association (IDA)** is a financial institution dedicated to providing development loans to the world's poorest countries.
 
• The International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) was established in 1944 with the objective of assisting war-torn European countries in rebuilding their infrastructure and economies.
 
• Following World War II, the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development expanded its mandate to include promoting global economic growth and poverty eradication.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **During the Bretton Woods Conference** in 1944, a gathering of the 44 Allied Nations of World War II aimed at establishing the post-war global financial order, the **IBRD **was established in anticipation of World War II's end.
 
• **The Bretton Woods Conference **was also the birthplace of the International Monetary Fund and the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development.
 
• The International Bank for Repair and Development's first loan was to the French government to help finance the reconstruction of essential infrastructure. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Bank of Reconstruction and Development (IBRD):**

 
 
• **Headquarters: Washington, D.C., U.S.**
 
• **Purpose: Development assistance, poverty reduction**
 
• **Founded: 1944**
 
• **Membership: 189 countries**
 
• **President of the World Bank: David Malpass**
